rationale: A symbol carries its own complexity -- how many keys or items it DIRECTLY holds -- so a wide configuration node scores above a leaf. The pre-fix lane had a file-level `configurationComplexity = visitedNodes`, which says nothing about any individual node, and no symbol carried a complexity at all. Pinned: a four-key object, a one-key leaf, a three-item sequence, and a nested object that scores 1 for holding one key rather than 3 for everything beneath it.

_everyRelationshipCarries.note: asserted by the lane census over 1,274 corpus files: 308,987/308,987 relationships carry a 1-based line_number and an evidenceClass
